retake.waitBetweenAttempts: May retake the next business day

gdl.permitMinAge: 15 (enrolled in approved driver education); 16 without driver education
gdl.provisionalMinAge: 16 yrs 180 days (with driver ed); 16 yrs 270 days (without)
gdl.fullLicenseMinAge: License held 6 months or age 21, whichever comes first
gdl.nightCurfew: First 180 days: no driving 10 p.m.-5 a.m.; then 11 p.m.-5 a.m. Sun-Fri and 1 a.m.-5 a.m. Sat/Sun (with exceptions)
gdl.passengerLimits: First 180 days: no passengers except immediate family (with exceptions)

requiredDocuments: Proof of lawful status in the U.S.
process.realIdNotes: Indiana issues REAL ID-compliant credentials (marked with a star). Since May 7, 2025, a REAL ID or other approved ID is required to board domestic flights. Matricula Consular cards are not accepted for identity or residency.
process.visionStandard: Vision screening required when obtaining, renewing, or amending a license or permit at a BMV branch; qualifying online renewals do not require an in-branch screening

facts.pointSuspensionThreshold: Points assigned per violation and remain 2 years; heavy accumulation over 24 months can lead to suspension. Two or more moving convictions in 12 months for drivers under 18/under 21 requires a Driver Safety Program or suspension
facts.moveOverRule: Change lanes away from, or slow below the posted limit for, stopped emergency, tow, and maintenance vehicles displaying flashing lights
facts.interstateMaxSpeed: 70 mph for passenger vehicles on rural interstates
facts.schoolZoneSpeed: Reduced limit as posted during school hours / when children are present
